attributes.title: Presence
attributes.lede: Swap a notice. Watch the gap.

lesson.concept: Exit lifetime affects layout as well as visibility
lesson.why: Presence retains removed content until its longest exit finishes. Sync, wait and popLayout differ in when arrivals and surrounding layout can proceed.
lesson.experiment: Remove a notice in each mode. Watch its slot after opacity falls, then change the exit timing to see how an invisible leaver can still occupy space.
lesson.pitfall: A long transform after a short fade leaves an invisible item holding layout. Keep the exit's visual and structural lifetimes intentional.
lesson.combine: Combine with layout for neighbour movement and preserve the yielded item's data throughout exit.
